Self.Wiki: This map object represents a region within the map.

TypeIndex.Wiki: The index of a region based on the region type.

Rotation.Wiki: Rotation of the region, in degrees.

RegionID.Wiki: The region's ID; the game looks regions up by it. Unique within the map.

ChildRegionNames.Wiki: Regions this region lists; read by the game. Empty on every retail region (composite shapes use their own list).

ParentRegionNames.Wiki: Regions that list this region as a child, stored as a second list. No game read was found. Empty on every retail region except GarageCamera lane points.

ActivationPartName.Wiki: The region remains inactive until the specified part is rendered. Empty means it is always active.

EntityID.Wiki: Identifies this region in event scripts.

UnkC08.Wiki: Read only by the patrol route setup, as a filter on Patrol walk points. -1 on every retail region except 4 Other regions (2, 3).

EntityGroupIDs.Wiki: The entity ID groups this region belongs to (8 slots; any slot can hold a group). Retail regions use at most one group, except one Other region with two.
